newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Montenegro Niksic steel works to invest $50 mln-Ta.
newsitem.headline: Montenegro Niksic steel works to invest $50 mln-Ta.

text.p: The Montenegro iron and steel mill Niksicka Zelezara plans to invest around $50 million in modernising its capacities, Yugoslav state news agency Tanjug reported on Monday.

In order for the steel works to be able to respond to market demands, a study has been ordered from French firm Usinor Sacilor for the reconstruction of Yugoslav iron and steel industry, assistant general manager for technical development Radisav Zujovic was quoted as saying.

Niksic has called for tenders from foreign manufacturers for the purchase and installation of a 65-tonne electric arc furnace and other equipment for the production of various kinds of wire worth nearly $50 million, Zujovic said.

The planned upgrading of equipment and reconstruction of existing capacities in the Niksic works depend primarily on financial possibilities, so state institutions should also be engaged in the process, Zujovic said.
"Such a large and important project would not be possible without state support," he added.
